summary: Executed requested backend + mobile-web frontend regression scope. Backend targeted pytest passed (5/5). Frontend flows for home layout, tabs/panels, create-item validation and submit, premium lock visibility, map plans/onboarding, and chat send were validated with Playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: Immediately after send, the newly sent message was not reliably visible in the current viewport text snapshot (likely no guaranteed auto-scroll to latest bubble).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings observed for deprecated shadow* style props and Image style.resizeMode usage.

action_items: Optional UX improvement: ensure chat detail auto-scrolls to latest message bubble after send for consistent visual confirmation.
Optional cleanup: address React Native deprecation warnings (shadow* styles, Image resizeMode style usage).
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; project-level guideline references EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Keep a single env key convention to avoid future config drift.
Friend action UI always shows success notice without validating non-2xx API responses; consider handling response.ok before success toast.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 requested checks; 1 low-priority chat visual consistency issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat message persistence confirmed through API and composer clear state. If retesting chat UI visibility, assert latest message bubble in viewport after auto-scroll behavior update.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction for low-priority chat UI inconsistency: open chat detail, send message, immediately read container text; new message may not appear in viewport snapshot although POST /api/chats/{id}/messages succeeds and subsequent GET contains the sent message. Likely due to list scroll position/virtualization timing rather than backend failure.
